was upgraded at Wells Fargo on Thursday as the investment firm said it sees “improving AI demand momentum.”

“While sentiment has improved, we think further confidence in a [re-acceleration] of demand can drive a modest re-rate in shares given current [valuation] at -2 STD dev 5-yr relative P/E to CDNS,” analyst Joe Quatrochi wrote in a note to clients. “We expect SNPS' 9/30 analyst day to highlight improving demand momentum into F2027 & a positive update to its [long-term] model.”
Quatrochi raised his rating on Synopsys to Overweight from Equal-Weight and upped his price target to $475 from $450.

title: Synopsys upgraded at Wells Fargo on improving momentum
